Post-edit checklist:
1. Code follows coding standards (naming, error handling, patterns)
2. Security: input validation, no SQL injection, no hardcoded secrets, auth checks
3. Artifact versioning: reference consumed artifact versions, name outputs as <type>-vN.md
4. Task tracking: update task status in docs/tasks/active-tasks.md if applicable
5. Run lint and tests before committing
6. Use conventional commits: <type>(<scope>): <description>
